title: Read-the-Hand Dribble
description: A partner raises one hand on one side; the dribbler must move the ball to the opposite side instantly, learning to keep the ball away from where a defender is reaching.

content.objective: Read where a defender's hand is and move the ball to the opposite side without looking down.
content.setup: Partners face each other one metre apart; one ball for the dribbler.
instructions: The dribbler starts a waist-high dribble in an athletic stance.
The partner holds up the left or right hand as if reaching for the ball.
The dribbler moves the ball to the opposite side with a crossover, between-the-legs or behind-the-back.
The partner switches hands at random, faster as the round goes on.
coachingPoints: Keep the eyes on the partner's chest to see both hands.
Change sides with the lowest move you can.
Recover your stance after every change.
commonMistakes: Moving the ball toward the raised hand.
Waiting for the hand to drop before reacting.
content.safety: Partner's hand stays up in the air; no actual swiping at the ball.
progressions: Partner may swipe gently with the raised hand.
regressions: Partner calls 'left' or 'right' as well as raising the hand.
Slower changes for the first round.
variations: Partner holds a pad instead of a hand.
Dribbler must also step away from the hand.
successCriteria: Correct side within one dribble on 9 of 10 cues.
No lost balls in a round.
content.gameApplication: Ball handlers keep possession by moving the ball away from the defender's active hand.
